name: The Clarence Gardens Hotel
accommodation: Around 30 rooms, many with sea views
suitableFor: Couples and small groups wanting sea views above North Bay
dogs: Pets may be accepted; contact hotel
beachAccess: On Blenheim Terrace above the North Bay shoreline
confirmedFeatures: Free Wi-Fi, Garden Room restaurant, Sea View Bar, non-smoking
overview: A boutique hotel on Blenheim Terrace, set above the North Bay shoreline with many rooms looking out to sea. Scarborough Castle and Peasholm Park are close by, and the South Bay and Spa are a short walk in the other direction. Free on-site parking is a bonus in this part of town.
surfTripFit: Clifftop sea views let you judge North Bay conditions from the room, and free parking makes loading boards easy.
